name: The Clockwork Deep: the Binding Forge
about: The lower Clockwork Deep (rooms C4-C8): C4 the Assembly Line, C5 the Frost Bell, C6 the Switchyard, C7 Bellows Bridge, and C8 the Binding Forge, a round chamber with Gorrak's anvil-pillar (boss arena placeholder, no fight yet). One long hall, entered from C3 of the Clockwork Deep.
